title: Vendor Evaluation - Monitoring Tools
summary: Evaluated DataDog, New Relic, and Grafana Cloud. DataDog leads on features but is 40% more expensive. Grafana Cloud good value but requires more setup. Decision needed by month end.
decisions: DataDog trial to run parallel for 2 weeks
Must include security review in evaluation
transcription: [13:00] Sarah Chen: Monitoring vendor evaluation. We've looked at three options. [13:03] Mike Torres: DataDog has the best out-of-box experience. APM, logs, metrics all integrated. But it's expensive. [13:08] Lisa Wang: How expensive? [13:10] Mike Torres: 40% more than New Relic at our scale. Roughly 18K/month vs 13K. [13:14] Sarah Chen: Grafana Cloud? [13:16] Mike Torres: 8K/month, but we'd need to run some components ourselves. More operational overhead. [13:20] Lisa Wang: What's the migration effort? [13:22] Mike Torres: DataDog: 2 weeks. Others: 4-6 weeks. [13:25] Sarah Chen: Let's get a trial going with DataDog. Run it parallel for two weeks. [13:28] Mike Torres: Already set up. Started yesterday. [13:30] Sarah Chen: Decision meeting next Friday.

risks.description: DataDog cost may exceed budget if usage grows
Migration disruption during busy Q1 period
